definitions.explanation: The ejection of lava, ash, and gases from a volcano.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{噴火|ふんか}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧300⟦{年|ねん}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧だ。
examples.english: The last time Mt. Fuji erupted was over 300 years ago.
The volcanic eruption caused a lot of damage.

examples.japanese: {噴火|ふんか}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A volcanic eruption warning was issued.

notes:
{噴火|ふんか} specifically refers to volcanic eruptions. Japan has many active volcanoes, making this an important word.

Common collocations:
- {噴火|ふんか}する (to erupt)
- {噴火|ふんか}{口|こう} (volcanic crater)
- {噴火|ふんか}{警報|けいほう} (eruption warning)
- {大|だい}{噴火|ふんか} (major eruption)

Related terms:
- {火山|かざん} (volcano)
- {溶岩|ようがん} (lava)
- {火山灰|かざんばい} (volcanic ash)
- {火口|かこう} (crater)
